# USA-REM

> USA-REM is the website and systems partner for construction companies: specialty contractors, engineers, suppliers, and general contractors. Rooted in Texas, with clients in Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, and Colorado, and building for construction companies across the country. The legal name is TX Real Estate Marketing LLC.

USA-REM writes and builds websites that connect a construction company's work to the people who depend on it: the owner choosing a builder, the general contractor comparing bids, the future hire, and the families, students, and workers on the other side of the work. Every website includes professional copywriting, design for phones, tablets, and desktops, full client ownership of every page, photo, and file, a zero-downtime launch, search and AI readiness, and an optional care plan for hosting, backups, security, and monthly edits. Foundation websites start at $2,999.

USA-REM also builds systems for construction companies: ordering portals, driver dispatch, inventory, Buildertrend setup, and automations built around how a company actually works.

Contact: 214.207.6956, info@usa-rem.com. Book a call: https://meetings-na2.hubspot.com/joshua40

## Services

- [Websites](https://usa-rem.com/websites): custom websites for contractors, engineers, and suppliers, with copywriting included and full ownership
- [Systems](https://usa-rem.com/systems): ordering portals, dispatch, inventory, Buildertrend setup, and automations
- [About](https://usa-rem.com/about): who USA-REM is and how the team works
- [Contact](https://usa-rem.com/contact): phone, email, and a contact form

## Who we build for

- [Specialty contractors and suppliers](https://usa-rem.com/specialty-contractors): electrical, masonry and stucco, concrete and asphalt, fiber and communications, stone fabrication, aggregates and building supply
- [Engineers](https://usa-rem.com/engineers): civil engineering, metro district engineering and services, stormwater, earth retention and shotcrete, specialty foundations
- [General contractors](https://usa-rem.com/general-contractors): multifamily, K-12, municipal and civic, faith-based, and commercial builders
